meaning.en: To be put in chains and thrown into prison.
meaning.zh: 被铁链锁着关进监狱，指被捕坐牢。

examples.zh: 这名贪官最终锒铛入狱。
examples.en: The corrupt official finally ended up behind bars.

examples.zh: 他因诈骗锒铛入狱，家人痛不欲生。
examples.en: He was jailed for fraud, leaving his family devastated.

examples.zh: 为了一时贪念锒铛入狱，实在不值。
examples.en: Ending up in prison for a moment's greed is just not worth it.

meaning.en: Of an official, travelling simply with few attendants.
meaning.zh: 乘坐轻便的车，带很少的随从，形容官员出行简朴。

examples.zh: 省长轻车简从，到农村调研。
examples.en: The governor went to the countryside to investigate, with no entourage.

examples.zh: 领导干部下基层要轻车简从，不搞迎来送往。
examples.en: Officials visiting the grassroots should travel light and skip the receptions.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，多用于公文、新闻。

meaning.en: To cooperate fully, each giving their all.
meaning.zh: 全力相互配合，共同完成任务。

examples.zh: 两国通力合作，打击跨国犯罪。
examples.en: The two countries are joining forces against cross-border crime.

examples.zh: 各部门通力合作，项目按时完成。
examples.en: With every department pulling together, the project finished on time.

examples.zh: 家长和学校要通力合作。
examples.en: Parents and schools need to work closely together.

meaning.en: Like a stone dropped into the sea — gone with no response.
meaning.zh: 像石头掉进大海里一样，比喻毫无消息或没有回音。

examples.zh: 我投了几十份简历，全都石沉大海。
examples.en: I sent out dozens of CVs and never heard back from any.

examples.zh: 他的投诉信如同石沉大海。
examples.en: His letter of complaint vanished without a trace.

examples.zh: 建议提交上去后便石沉大海。
examples.en: Once the proposal was submitted, nothing more was heard.

usage.en: Predicate; often 如/如同石沉大海.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“如石沉大海”。

meaning.en: To conceal one's identity and live in obscurity.
meaning.zh: 隐瞒自己的真实姓名，不让别人知道自己的身份。

examples.zh: 他隐姓埋名几十年，默默从事国防科研。
examples.en: For decades he worked on defence research incognito.

examples.zh: 退出江湖后，他隐姓埋名，回乡种地。
examples.en: Leaving the limelight, he returned home to farm under an assumed name.

meaning.en: Indignant and resentful at unfair treatment.
meaning.zh: 心中不服，感到气愤。

examples.zh: 没评上先进，他心里愤愤不平。
examples.en: He felt hard done by after missing out on the award.

examples.zh: 球迷对裁判的判罚愤愤不平。
examples.en: The fans were indignant at the referee's decision.

meaning.en: Feeling at ease because one believes one is in the right; often ironic of someone who should feel guilty.
meaning.zh: 自以为做的事合情合理，心里很坦然；也常含讽刺意味。

examples.zh: 我凭本事赚钱，花得心安理得。
examples.en: I earned this money by my own effort, so I spend it with a clear conscience.

examples.zh: 他拿着公司的钱旅游，还心安理得。
examples.en: He holidays on company money without a qualm.

examples.zh: 只有尽了全力，才能心安理得。
examples.en: Only when you've done your best can you have peace of mind.

meaning.en: So many loose ends or tasks that it's hard to know where to start.
meaning.zh: 形容事情纷繁复杂，头绪很多。

equivalents: a thousand and one things to do

examples.zh: 新公司刚成立，工作千头万绪。
examples.en: The company has just started and there are a thousand and one things to do.

examples.zh: 我心里千头万绪，不知从何说起。
examples.en: My mind is in such a whirl I don't know where to begin.

examples.zh: 灾后重建千头万绪。
examples.en: Post-disaster reconstruction involves countless tasks.

natural: watch what one says and does

meaning.en: To be careful in speech and cautious in action.
meaning.zh: 说话、做事都小心谨慎。

examples.zh: 身为公众人物，更要谨言慎行。
examples.en: As a public figure, you need to be especially careful what you say and do.

examples.zh: 刚到新单位，他处处谨言慎行。
examples.en: New to the job, he watched every word and step.

examples.zh: 父亲常教导我们要谨言慎行。
examples.en: Father always taught us to be careful in word and deed.

meaning.en: Time has passed and circumstances have changed.
meaning.zh: 时间过去了，情况也变了。

examples.zh: 时过境迁，当年的小镇已变成了大城市。
examples.en: Times have changed: the small town of those days is now a big city.

examples.zh: 时过境迁，那些争吵早就不重要了。
examples.en: It's all water under the bridge — those quarrels hardly matter now.

examples.zh: 这项政策时过境迁，需要修改。
examples.en: Circumstances have changed and the policy needs revising.

meaning.en: A strategically vital place that all sides must fight for.
meaning.zh: 必定要争夺的战略要地，也比喻竞争中的关键领域。

examples.zh: 这座城市自古就是兵家必争之地。
examples.en: Since ancient times this city has been a key strategic prize.

examples.zh: 中国市场已成为汽车厂商的必争之地。
examples.en: China has become a battleground every carmaker must fight for.

usage.en: Object; often 兵家必争之地.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“兵家必争之地”。

meaning.en: To occupy a high position looking down; by extension, to be condescending.
meaning.zh: 处在高处，俯视下面，形容占据有利地势；也比喻盛气凌人。

examples.zh: 敌军居高临下，我们只能智取。
examples.en: The enemy held the high ground, so we had to outwit them.

examples.zh: 他说话总是居高临下，让人很不舒服。
examples.en: He always talks down to people, which makes them uncomfortable.

examples.zh: 这座城堡居高临下，易守难攻。
examples.en: Commanding the heights, the castle is easy to defend and hard to take.

meaning.en: Every matter, large or small.
meaning.zh: 事情不论大小。

examples.zh: 他事无巨细，都要亲自过问。
examples.en: He insists on overseeing everything, big or small.

examples.zh: 妈妈事无巨细地帮我准备好了行李。
examples.en: Mum packed my bags for me down to the last detail.

usage.en: Adverbial or subject; often 事无巨细，都/一律….
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“事无巨细，都……”。

meaning.en: To exploit every opening; to be everywhere and pervasive (usually negative).
meaning.zh: 比喻利用一切机会钻空子，也形容无处不渗透。

examples.zh: 现在的广告无孔不入。
examples.en: Advertising gets in everywhere these days.

examples.zh: 骗子无孔不入，老人一定要提高警惕。
examples.en: Scammers exploit every opening, so the elderly must stay alert.

examples.zh: 病毒无孔不入，防护措施必须到位。
examples.en: The virus finds every gap, so protection has to be watertight.

meaning.en: To vanish completely, like smoke and clouds.
meaning.zh: 像烟和云一样消散，比喻事物消失得干干净净。

examples.zh: 看到孩子平安回来，一切担心都烟消云散了。
examples.en: When the child came home safe, all the worry melted away.

examples.zh: 两人握手言和，多年的恩怨烟消云散。
examples.en: They shook hands, and years of grudges vanished.

examples.zh: 计划一失败，他的梦想便烟消云散。
examples.en: When the plan failed, his dreams went up in smoke.

meaning.en: To sit directly on the ground.
meaning.zh: 在地上坐下（古人铺席于地而坐）。

examples.zh: 同学们在草地上席地而坐，听老师讲故事。
examples.en: The pupils sat on the grass listening to the teacher's story.

examples.zh: 音乐节上，很多人席地而坐。
examples.en: At the music festival lots of people sat on the ground.

meaning.en: Filled with righteous indignation.
meaning.zh: 胸中充满了因正义而生的愤怒。

examples.zh: 看到虐待动物的视频，网友们义愤填膺。
examples.en: Seeing the animal-cruelty video, netizens were outraged.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，村民们义愤填膺。
examples.en: The villagers were up in arms at the news.

natural: if you're not moving forward, you're falling behind

meaning.en: Failing to make progress means falling back.
meaning.zh: 不前进就会后退。

equivalents: if you stand still, you fall behind

examples.zh: 学习如逆水行舟，不进则退。
examples.en: Learning is like rowing upstream: stop and you drift back.

examples.zh: 市场竞争激烈，企业不进则退。
examples.en: In a fierce market, a company that stands still falls behind.

usage.en: Predicate; often after 学如逆水行舟.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常接在“学如逆水行舟”之后。

meaning.en: Of a leader, to go ahead of the troops; to lead by example.
meaning.zh: 作战时将领亲自冲在士兵前面，比喻领导带头。

examples.zh: 将军身先士卒，冲在最前线。
examples.en: The general led from the front, charging at the head of his men.

examples.zh: 救灾中，村支书身先士卒。
examples.en: In the relief work, the village party secretary led by example.

examples.zh: 老板身先士卒，第一个加班。
examples.en: The boss set the example by being the first to stay late.

meaning.en: To treat different cases alike; to generalise. Usually negated: 不能一概而论.
meaning.zh: 用同一个标准来对待或处理，多用于否定。

examples.zh: 每个孩子情况不同，不能一概而论。
examples.en: Every child is different; you can't generalise.

examples.zh: 网红产品也有好有坏，不可一概而论。
examples.en: Influencer products vary — you can't tar them all with the same brush.

usage.en: Predicate; almost always negated: 不能/不可一概而论.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用否定式“不能一概而论”。

meaning.en: To do something perfunctorily just to get it over with.
meaning.zh: 办事不认真，马马虎虎应付过去。

examples.zh: 作业要认真做，不能敷衍了事。
examples.en: Do your homework properly — no half-hearted efforts.

examples.zh: 对群众的投诉，有的部门敷衍了事。
examples.en: Some departments just go through the motions with public complaints.

examples.zh: 这份报告明显是敷衍了事写出来的。
examples.en: This report was obviously dashed off.

meaning.en: To invent all sorts of pretexts, especially for charging fees or misusing funds.
meaning.zh: 想方设法定出许多名目，以达到某种不正当的目的。

examples.zh: 一些学校巧立名目乱收费。
examples.en: Some schools invent all sorts of pretexts to charge extra fees.

examples.zh: 他们巧立名目，挪用公款。
examples.en: They misappropriated public funds under various guises.

usage.en: Predicate; usually followed by what is done (乱收费, 挪用…).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后常接“乱收费”等。

meaning.en: Only when there is absolutely no alternative.
meaning.zh: 实在没有办法，不得不这样。

examples.zh: 不到万不得已，我不会向别人借钱。
examples.en: I'd never borrow money unless I absolutely had to.

examples.zh: 手术是万不得已的选择。
examples.en: Surgery is the last resort.

examples.zh: 万不得已的时候，可以打这个电话。
examples.en: If all else fails, call this number.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 不到万不得已….
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“不到万不得已”。

meaning.en: So loud it almost deafens.
meaning.zh: 声音大得耳朵都快被震聋了。

examples.zh: 体育馆里响起震耳欲聋的欢呼声。
examples.en: Deafening cheers rang out in the stadium.

examples.zh: 隔壁装修的声音震耳欲聋。
examples.en: The renovation next door is ear-splitting.

examples.zh: 酒吧里音乐震耳欲聋。
examples.en: The music in the bar was deafening.

natural: not what it used to be

meaning.en: The present can't be compared with the past — usually meaning things have greatly improved.
meaning.zh: 现在不是过去能比的，多指变化很大（多指变好）。

equivalents: a world away from the old days
not what it used to be

examples.zh: 家乡的面貌今非昔比。
examples.en: My hometown looks completely different from the old days.

examples.zh: 如今他的地位今非昔比。
examples.en: His standing is a world away from what it was.

examples.zh: 中国队的实力今非昔比。
examples.en: The Chinese team is far stronger than it used to be.
